dialogues.jp:
関係者のところを回ってみたが、さくらの居場
所をつきとめることは出来なかった――と言う
か、存在していた痕跡すら見つからない。
dialogues.en: "Hey!"
dialogues.text: "Hey!"

dialogues.jp:
学園の記録にすら残っていないのは、あいつが
消したのか、元から存在していないのか……。
dialogues.en: I rush to her and rub her back.
dialogues.text: I rush to her and rub her back.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん……ごめん。前も聞かれたけど、やっぱ
　りそんな子知らないや」
dialogues.en: "Uhh... huhh... hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Uhh... huhh... hahaha..."

dialogues.jp:
音夢がここまで完璧だと、どうやら俺だけがア
イツのことを覚えているらしい。もしくは、俺
だけがそういう夢を見ていたのか……。
「あぁ、どうにも最近、考えが悲観的だな」
dialogues.en:
When Nemu takes her hands away from her mouth, I see piles
of red cherry petals in her mouth.
dialogues.text:
When Nemu takes her hands away from her mouth, I see piles
of red cherry petals in her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「悲観的？　ダメだよ、お兄ちゃんから楽観を
　とったらなにも残らないんだから」
dialogues.en: "I feel like a cherry tree is growing in my body."
dialogues.text: "I feel like a cherry tree is growing in my body."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あのなぁ」
dialogues.en:
She carefully collects the cherry petals so as not to spill
any, and throws them in the trashcan.
dialogues.text:
She carefully collects the cherry petals so as not to spill
any, and throws them in the trashcan.

dialogues.jp: 慌てて駆けより、背中をさする。
dialogues.en:
When I look at the trashcan, there are a lot of petals in
there.
dialogues.text:
When I look at the trashcan, there are a lot of petals in
there.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が口にあてていた手を離すと、そこには真っ
赤な桜の花びらがつもっていた。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんかねぇ、身体の中に桜の木でもはえちゃっ
　たのかな」
dialogues.en: "The nurse threw them away when she swept up... It hurt..."
dialogues.text: "The nurse threw them away when she swept up... It hurt..."

dialogues.jp:
冗談めかして、手慣れたように桜の花びらがこ
ぼれないようにゴミ箱に――。
dialogues.en: "If you know that, you don't need to say it."
dialogues.text: "If you know that, you don't need to say it."

dialogues.jp:
目を向けたゴミ箱には、花びらがごっそりと捨
てられていた。
dialogues.en: I smile as I stir up her hair.
dialogues.text: I smile as I stir up her hair.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「か、看護師さんが表の掃除をしたときにゴミ
　を捨てて――苦しい」
dialogues.en: "Uh, come on! I'm not a child..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, come on! I'm not a child..."

dialogues.jp: 髪の毛をかきまぜて笑う。
dialogues.en: "What's wrong with doing this?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong with doing this?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、もぅ！　子供じゃないんだから……」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... aahhh..."
dialogues.text: "Hmm... aahhh..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「別にいいじゃんか」
dialogues.en: "Are you tired?"
dialogues.text: "Are you tired?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Uh... yeah, but I'm not going to sleep now."
dialogues.text: "Uh... yeah, but I'm not going to sleep now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「眠いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Why not?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Why not?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん……でも寝ない」
dialogues.en:
"Well, um... If I sleep now, I feel like I won't ever wake
up. It sounds weird, doesn't it? I'm like someone on their
deathbed."
dialogues.text:
"Well, um... If I sleep now, I feel like I won't ever wake
up. It sounds weird, doesn't it? I'm like someone on their
deathbed."

dialogues.jp:
俺の肩によりかかって、音夢が小さくため息を
つく。
dialogues.en: Nemu breathes a quiet sigh, leaning on my shoulder.
dialogues.text: Nemu breathes a quiet sigh, leaning on my shoulder.

dialogues.jp: なにか、感じ取っているのだろうか。
dialogues.en: I wonder if she might be feeling something I don't know.
dialogues.text: I wonder if she might be feeling something I don't know.

dialogues.jp: 「……大丈夫だよ。また、普通に起きれるって」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. You'll wake up soon."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. You'll wake up soon."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうかな……うん……お兄ちゃんが言うんだ
　からそうだよね」
dialogues.en:
"Really? Hm... But if you say so, oniichan, it's got to be
true."
dialogues.text:
"Really? Hm... But if you say so, oniichan, it's got to be
true."

dialogues.jp:
俺の手を握って、そのまま倒れこむように音夢
はベッドに横たわる。
dialogues.en: Nemu falls into the bed, holding my hand.
dialogues.text: Nemu falls into the bed, holding my hand.

dialogues.jp: 「寝るまでは一緒にいてやるから」
dialogues.en: "I'll stay here until you go to sleep."
dialogues.text: "I'll stay here until you go to sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
それで安心したのか、細く長い息を吐いて音夢
が｛まぶた／瞼｝を閉じる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu relaxes when she hears me, and closes her eyes,
breathing out slowly.
dialogues.text:
Nemu relaxes when she hears me, and closes her eyes,
breathing out slowly.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は再び目を開けることが出来るのだろうか。
dialogues.en: I'm not sure if Nemu will open her eyes again.
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if Nemu will open her eyes again.

dialogues.jp: いつか、さくらが言っていた。
dialogues.en: Sakura asked me one day.
dialogues.text: Sakura asked me one day.

dialogues.jp:
自分と音夢のどちらかだけを選ぶとしたら――
出来るだけ両方を救う。俺の答えはそんなんだっ
たか。
dialogues.en:
If I had to choose Nemu or Sakura, which one I would take...
I said I would save both of them. That was my answer.
dialogues.text:
If I had to choose Nemu or Sakura, which one I would take...
I said I would save both of them. That was my answer.

dialogues.jp: 今は？
dialogues.en: How about now?
dialogues.text: How about now?

dialogues.jp: どちらかが消えるとしたら――。
dialogues.en: If either of them have to disappear...
dialogues.text: If either of them have to disappear...

dialogues.jp: 「……なぁ、音夢、変なこと聞くけどさ」
dialogues.en: "Nemu, can I ask you a stupid question?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu, can I ask you a stupid question?"

dialogues.jp: ｛かす／微｝かに瞼が開く。
dialogues.en: She opens her eyes slightly.
dialogues.text: She opens her eyes slightly.

dialogues.jp:
「なんでも願いが叶う世界にいたらさ、お前は
　なにをお願いする？　いや、お前みたいな年
　頃の子は？」
dialogues.en:
"If you lived in a world where you could get anything you
want, what would you wish for? I mean, as a girl of your
age."
dialogues.text:
"If you lived in a world where you could get anything you
want, what would you wish for? I mean, as a girl of your
age."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「…………そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Let me see..."
dialogues.text: "Let me see..."

dialogues.jp: 「寝てる？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sleeping?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sleeping?"

dialogues.jp: 間を置いて音夢が首を振る。
dialogues.en: Nemu paused a while, and then shook her head.
dialogues.text: Nemu paused a while, and then shook her head.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あはは、多分好きな人と結ばれますようにっ
　て……でも」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha, I'd probably wish to get together with the person I
love, but..."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha, I'd probably wish to get together with the person I
love, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でも？」
dialogues.en: "But?"
dialogues.text: "But?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。多分それは、すごく怖いことなんだろ
　うね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. But I think that would be very scary."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. But I think that would be very scary."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんでだ？　だって、その子のこと好きなん
　だろう？」
dialogues.en: "Why? You love that person, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "Why? You love that person, don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって、なんでも叶ってしまう世界なら――」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if it was a world where you can make your wish come
true..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, if it was a world where you can make your wish come
true..."

dialogues.jp: 小さく笑って、
dialogues.en: A slight smile on her face.
dialogues.text: A slight smile on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「相手の気持ちが嘘だってこともあるんでしょ？
　それは、もう、自分の好きな人じゃないんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"The other person might feel something different. And that
would mean he's not the person you loved any more."
dialogues.text:
"The other person might feel something different. And that
would mean he's not the person you loved any more."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それでも、そうなってしまったら、相手を拒
　否することが出来ないだろうね……それが怖
　いよ」
dialogues.en:
"Even so, if I still love him, I don't think I could deny
him... That's what I am afraid of."
dialogues.text:
"Even so, if I still love him, I don't think I could deny
him... That's what I am afraid of."

dialogues.jp: それきり、音夢が口を開くことはなかった。
dialogues.en: After that, Nemu says no more.
dialogues.text: After that, Nemu says no more.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の手が繋がれっぱなしで、このままで居て
やろうとも思ったが、残された時間とやらを考
えるとすぐに動くべきなのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I thought I would stay here with her, holding her hand, but
I should get going since I don't have much time left.
dialogues.text:
I thought I would stay here with her, holding her hand, but
I should get going since I don't have much time left.

dialogues.jp:
こんなとき、ゲームの主人公なんかは燃え上がっ
て走り回るものなのだろうが。
dialogues.en:
If this was some kind of hero in a game, he'd be running
around in excitement.
dialogues.text:
If this was some kind of hero in a game, he'd be running
around in excitement.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったりぃな」
dialogues.en: "What a pain in the neck..."
dialogues.text: "What a pain in the neck..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらに会っても、かけるべき言葉が思いつか
ないし、自分でもどうすればいいのか、分から
ない。
dialogues.en:
When I meet Sakura, I probably won't know what to say, or
what to do.
dialogues.text:
When I meet Sakura, I probably won't know what to say, or
what to do.

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくりと立ち上がって、音夢を起こさないよ
うに――皮肉だが――指をはずしていく。
dialogues.en:
Standing up slowly, I gradually release my fingers from
hers, so as not to wake her up, even though it looks ironic.
dialogues.text:
Standing up slowly, I gradually release my fingers from
hers, so as not to wake her up, even though it looks ironic.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、っと」
dialogues.en: "Oh well..."
dialogues.text: "Oh well..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「さくらちゃんを助けてあげてね、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Please, save Sakura-chan, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Please, save Sakura-chan, niisan."

dialogues.jp:
振り返っても、音夢はさきほどと変わらぬ姿で
眠りに落ちている。
dialogues.en: When I turn around, Nemu is still sleeping like before.
dialogues.text: When I turn around, Nemu is still sleeping like before.

dialogues.jp: 寝言か、わざとか――。
dialogues.en: Was it talking in her sleep, or teasing me on purpose?
dialogues.text: Was it talking in her sleep, or teasing me on purpose?

dialogues.jp: 「ま、俺なりにやるさ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'll do what I have to do."
dialogues.text: "Well, I'll do what I have to do."

dialogues.jp:
さくらがお別れを言いにきたってことは、今日
中に決着をつける気だろう。
dialogues.en:
Sakura came here to say good-bye, which means she'll
probably be ending things today.
dialogues.text:
Sakura came here to say good-bye, which means she'll
probably be ending things today.

dialogues.jp: 「そうか……枯れるのか」
dialogues.en: "I see. She will die like a petal."
dialogues.text: "I see. She will die like a petal."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく、窓辺によって街並みを眺めた。
dialogues.en: I look at the cityscape from the window.
dialogues.text: I look at the cityscape from the window.

dialogues.jp:
魔法が解けるということは、この枯れない桜が
枯れるということだ。
dialogues.en: To break the spell means these cherry blossoms will pass.
dialogues.text: To break the spell means these cherry blossoms will pass.

dialogues.jp:
「ようやく、俺も、この島も、目が覚めてきた
　ようだな」
dialogues.en:
"I think it's finally time for me and this island to wake
up."
dialogues.text:
"I think it's finally time for me and this island to wake
up."

dialogues.jp: さくらは、何もかもを終わらせようとしている。
dialogues.en: Sakura wants to have closure in everything.
dialogues.text: Sakura wants to have closure in everything.

dialogues.jp:
良いも悪いも。悲喜こもごもも。一切合切。ピ
ンからキリまで。
dialogues.en:
Good and bad. Hope and despair. Anything and everything. All
sorts of things.
dialogues.text:
Good and bad. Hope and despair. Anything and everything. All
sorts of things.

dialogues.jp: だが俺は――音夢の言葉を借りるのならば。
dialogues.en: But I would say according to Nemu...
dialogues.text: But I would say according to Nemu...

dialogues.jp: はじめるために、終わらせるべきだろう。
dialogues.en: To begin something, you have to end it first.
dialogues.text: To begin something, you have to end it first.

dialogues.jp: ◆女の子の気持ち◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu◆

dialogues.jp: 音夢はさくらを覚えていなかった。
dialogues.en: "Uhh."
dialogues.text: "Uhh."

dialogues.jp: 学園にもさくらのいた痕跡すら残っていない。
dialogues.en:
I asked different people about where Sakura might be, but I
couldn't find out where she was. Or rather, I couldn't even
find any evidence she ever existed.
dialogues.text:
I asked different people about where Sakura might be, but I
couldn't find out where she was. Or rather, I couldn't even
find any evidence she ever existed.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの存在と、音夢の病状……それを秤にか
けた時、俺は……。
dialogues.en:
The school record doesn't have her name. I wonder if she
erased it, or if it was never there.
dialogues.text:
The school record doesn't have her name. I wonder if she
erased it, or if it was never there.

dialogues.jp:
そして、みんなの記憶を消したさくらは、いっ
たい何を望んでいるのだろう？
dialogues.en:
"Hm... Sorry. Somebody asked me that once before, but I've
no idea who the girl is."
dialogues.text:
"Hm... Sorry. Somebody asked me that once before, but I've
no idea who the girl is."

dialogues.jp: なんでも願いの叶う魔法は怖い、と音夢は言う。
dialogues.en: "I see. Well, it's okay."
dialogues.text: "I see. Well, it's okay."

dialogues.jp:
好きな人の気持ちさえも、嘘になってしまうか
もしれないから、と。
dialogues.en:
Nemu sticks to her answer, which means I must be the only
one who remembers Sakura, or who saw her dream.
dialogues.text:
Nemu sticks to her answer, which means I must be the only
one who remembers Sakura, or who saw her dream.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は、さくらを覚えているのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: "Oh man, my way of thinking's got too negative these days."
dialogues.text: "Oh man, my way of thinking's got too negative these days."

dialogues.jp:
けれど、そんなことを気にしている余裕なんて
なかった。
dialogues.en:
"Overly negative? That's not good. If I take away your
optimism, what else do you have, oniichan?"
dialogues.text:
"Overly negative? That's not good. If I take away your
optimism, what else do you have, oniichan?"

dialogues.jp: 終わらせなければならない。
dialogues.en: "Excuse me?!"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me?!"

dialogues.jp:
止まってしまった時を、再び動き出させるため
に……。
dialogues.en: "Hahaha... akkh, cough..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha... akkh, cough..."
